canonical_title: Flying qualities levels for failure states

versions.title_at_revision: Flying qualities levels for failure states
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Allowable Levels for Specific Air Vehicle Failure States paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct FMECA to assess the air vehicle flying qualities in failure states as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Allowable Levels for Specific Air Vehicle Failure States paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, specific failure states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct FMET to assess the air vehicle flying qualities in failure states as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Allowable Levels for Specific Air Vehicle Failure States paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, specific failure states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
  (2) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle flying qualities in failure states as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Allowable Levels for Specific Air Vehicle Failure States paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, specific failure states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (3) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle flying qualities in failure states as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Allowable Levels for Specific Air Vehicle Failure States paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, specific failure states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
